correctness.rationale: For unit u,v, Gamma=(||Pu||||Pv||-<Pu,Pv>)/(1-<u,v>) equals d/n minus the projected norm-difference square divided by 2(1-<u,v>). Along any great circle h(t)=||P(cos t u+sin t w)|| belongs to periodic H^1. Fourier Parseval and |e^{iktheta}-1|<=|k||e^{itheta}-1| bound finite-chord squared differences by the expected squared tangential derivative. For Haar rank-d projector Q=P^T P, idempotence and rotational invariance give E|hprime|^2=(n-d)/(n(n-1)), proving sharp chordal constant. Dominated convergence for coalescing directions proves sharpness and inf E Gamma=(d-1)/(n-1), including d=1 and d=n endpoints. Exact Euclidean ball section oracle calculation yields matching optimization witness; transfer to general strongly convex sets relies on existing source comparison-ball hypotheses, not an unrestricted arbitrary-domain claim. Independent rational/all-dimension and small-angle checks passed.
residual_risks: Exact sharpness is ball comparison-oracle uniform factor, not a sharp general nonlinear-set rate coefficient.
Small-angle limit is sharp supremum, not attained at separated directions for d<n.
